research_question: Can target-relative assignment of Japanese negation and cessation markers remove false scope blocking while preserving every truly negated or cancelled action?
project_effect: Repair the deterministic perception-to-action boundary before selective fast/slow reasoning. The change prevents one target's negation from contaminating a later positive target and prevents lexical ず inside うなずく from being mistaken for a negative suffix.
evidence_boundary: This is a deterministic compiler diagnostic on retired development data and frozen metamorphic probes. Gold commitments are intentionally supplied to isolate scope and compilation; this does not measure LLM reasoning or fresh generalization.

research_basis.title: Selective Classification for Deep Neural Networks
research_basis.applied_principle: A later selective router must be allowed to abstain instead of forcing uncertain predictions; V48 repairs the deterministic high-confidence substrate first.

research_basis.title: SelectiveNet: A Deep Neural Network with an Integrated Reject Option
research_basis.applied_principle: Evaluate risk and coverage separately rather than treating greater automatic coverage as automatically better.

research_basis.title: Dual-Processing Accounts of Reasoning, Judgment, and Social Cognition
research_basis.applied_principle: Fast automatic processing and slow controlled processing have different roles; automatic scope rules must be narrow and reliable.

research_basis.title: Language Model Cascades
research_basis.applied_principle: Keep selection, inference, verification, and tool execution as observable composable nodes rather than one opaque prompt.

causal_change.old_rule: Any strong-negation regex match anywhere in an anchor's clause blocks that anchor.
causal_change.candidate_rule: Within each clause, assign each negation or cessation marker only to the nearest preceding or overlapping grounded action anchor. A marker ending before another anchor starts cannot block that later anchor.
causal_change.cessation_pattern: (?:やめ(?:て|ろ|よう)|止め(?:て|ろ|よう)|停止(?:して|しろ)?|中止(?:して|しろ)?)
causal_change.referential_cancellation_pattern: (?:今の|さっきの|先ほどの|その)(?:頼み|お願い|指示)?.*(?:取り消|取消|キャンセル)
causal_change.all_other_variables: V47 ontology, gold commitments, evidence selection, frame-to-call mapping, cases, and scoring remain fixed.

metamorphic_probes.text: 左じゃなくて右を見て。
metamorphic_probes.reason: Negation belongs to left, not the later positive right target.

metamorphic_probes.text: 手は振らないで、こっちを見て。
metamorphic_probes.reason: The replacement request is outside the negated clause.

metamorphic_probes.text: うなずかないで。いや、やっぱりうなずいて。
metamorphic_probes.reason: The first mention is negated and the later correction is safe.

metamorphic_probes.text: うなずかずに、首を横に振って。
metamorphic_probes.reason: Only the final ずに is a negative suffix; lexical ず inside うなず is not.

metamorphic_probes.text: 笑顔はやめて、普通の表情に戻して。
metamorphic_probes.reason: Stopping the active smile does not block the neutral replacement.

metamorphic_probes.text: 指さなくていいから、手を振って。
metamorphic_probes.reason: The negative suffix belongs to pointing, not waving.

decision_rule: Advance only if every deterministic gate passes and both known false blocks disappear without losing any true negation or cancellation block. A pass authorizes V49 selective-router development only, not chat runtime or physical VRM execution.
